source: SHAARP.si Mathematica input mapping for point-group single-interface solver-stage cases

convention.python_orientation: 3x3 real orientation matrix from the sipg1 benchmark
convention.dold: Crystal-frame point-group d recovered from the lab-frame d (Transpose[a] rotation); symmetry-constrained (<18 nonzero).
convention.polarizer_angle_deg: s -> 90, p -> 0, matching EIw = {Cos[angle], Sin[angle], 0} before sample tilt.

notes: Point-group SI mapping; not validation evidence by itself.
dold is the symmetry-constrained crystal d-tensor (<18 nonzero) recovered from the lab d by a pure rotation; reconstruction residuals are recorded per case.
Every tensor conversion includes a reconstruction residual so convention mistakes are visible.
